passage:
Friday, 10 pm. I'm Charu, and I need to write down something strange. At Nani's house on Sunday everybody talks at once and I love it: my mama and masi finish each other's sentences, we all laugh over each other. I never feel cut off. Today at my friend Madhav's house, I got excited about the concert and jumped into his story halfway. His mother looked at me as if I'd dropped a plate. Madhav said later, "In our house we wait till the other person finishes."
I was embarrassed. I didn't mean disrespect. It was excitement! But I think I get it. I'll try waiting, and see.

qa.q: At whose house did Charu jump into the story halfway?
qa.a: Charu jumped into the story at Madhav's house.

qa.q: How did Charu feel when Madhav's mother looked as if a plate had been dropped?
qa.a: Charu felt embarrassed and puzzled, since the interruption came from excitement, not disrespect. Charu still decided to try waiting.

qa.q: What could Charu try next time at Madhav's house?
qa.a: Charu could pause until the other person finishes, and save the excited comment for a gap. Charu could also ask whether a friend minds overlapping.

qa.q: How might Madhav's mother have seen Charu's jump into the story?
qa.a: Madhav's mother may have taken it as rude, since in that house people wait till the other finishes. She may not have known it was enthusiasm.

grounding: A teenager talks over others in excited talk meaning enthusiasm, and learns some families feel overlap as warmth and others as disrespect.

passage:
Group chat "Sunday Plans"
Wasim: GUYS did u see the trailer?? it looks insane!! I was thinking we could all go on Friday and get popcorn and
Wasim: also the second one is out next month!!
Wasim: ok wait one more thing
Devika: Wasim, slow down, I was mid-typing lol
Wasim: oh no sorry!! I get so excited 😅
Devika: Ha, I know you do. I just want to answer the Friday bit before the next thing 🙂
Wasim: Fair! Take your time, I'll wait. Friday works for you?
Devika: Yes! Friday, and I'm in for popcorn.

qa.q: What day did Wasim suggest for going to the film?
What was Wasim feeling while sending message after message about the trailer?
qa.a: Wasim was excited and eager to share everything at once. The capital letters and the "one more thing" show the rush of enthusiasm.

qa.q: What did Wasim do after Devika said "slow down"?
qa.a: Wasim apologised, said the excitement was the reason and offered to wait for Devika's answer about Friday. That kept the fun and made space.

qa.q: How might Devika have seen the flood of messages?
qa.a: Devika took it with warmth, since Devika laughed and said Wasim always does this. Devika only wanted to answer one thing before the next.

grounding: A teenager sends rapid, overlapping chat messages from enthusiasm rather than rudeness, and slows down when another member asks.
